title: Convene the regime interpretation meeting on governed RegimeState transitions

acceptance.1: MT-5 (regime_interpretation) is convened once per transition via MeetingTriggers._mt5 when a governed (active, approved-model) RegimeState transition occurs on the macro axis or on the primary axis of any enrolled pool, with a tenant-scoped transition idempotency key and rotating trading-persona chair; missing or proposed/candidate records record not_fired (no_governed_regime_record or proposed_regime_record_only) and never convene a meeting.
acceptance.2: The MT-5 case file carries the governed regime_records (facts:regime_record:*), the market_state measurement (facts:market_state:*), and each enrolled pool's exposure (facts:pool_exposure:*); consultation execution writes each participant's interpretation to its own persona memory store and preserves the minority view in a published dissent memo referenced by the meeting minutes.
acceptance.3: Tests in services/persona/test_meeting_triggers.py and services/persona/test_persona_cycle_controller.py cover macro and primary-axis transitions, repeated reads of the same transition (same trigger instance, second enrolled persona in the same session, and subsequent unchanged session), missing records, and proposed records.
acceptance.4: docs/deployment/evidence/MEETING-REGIME-TRIGGER-20261115/evidence.json records exact verification commands and results and contains no credentials.
